label: PE-3(1)
title: System Access

statement.prose: Enforce physical access authorizations to the system in addition to the physical access controls for the facility at {{ insert: param, pe-03.01_odp }}.

guidance: Control of physical access to the system provides additional physical security for those areas within facilities where there is a concentration of system components.

params.label: physical spaces
guidelines: physical spaces containing one or more components of the system are defined;
